notes.title: Bit-cremental: Fishistry Color, a nostalgia-enhanced DLC, is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi, my fisher friends!

I just released a new aesthetically upgraded DLC for Bit-cremental: Fishistry that plays along with the classic Game Boy inspired graphics.

It's just a little thank you for the support and provides a way to further support my future development endeavors, because it only gets better from here!

Happy fishing!

notes.title: v1.2 - New Upgrades + QoL
notes.notes:
Hey, my fisher folks!

The first big update for Fishistry is out now, and thanks to a bit of feedback I've been able to improve the gameplay a bit. Let's jump right in!

[h3][b]New[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Auto-feeder[/b]: You can now purchase and upgrade an auto-feeder that will randomly spawn food pellets over time. This is great for a little extra boost when in full idle mode.
[*] [b]Auto-stocking Minimum Increase[/b]: The auto-stocker has been upgraded to allow you to upgrade all the way to keeping the pond stocked to the maximum fish allowed. You do have to purchase the first level to even use it, but it's very inexpensive.
[/list]

[h3][b]QoL Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now Right-Click on the menu to go backwards a menu tab.
[/list]

Since this was a slightly larger update with the upgrades, I have been testing it quite a bit to ensure every angle is covered, and I will keep at it. If you find anything, please let me know!

That's it for this update. I hope you're enjoying your fishing adventure, and I look forward to the next update.

Thanks for your support!

Happy Fishing.

notes.title: Bit-cremental: Fishistry is Out Now!
notes.notes:
The day has come! Bit-cremental: Fishistry has cast its line onto Steam!

As a big fan of incremental games - whether idlers, clickers, or hybrids - I couldn’t resist creating another one. This time, I wanted to bring a retro-inspired idle experience, blending my love for fishing games with the charm of classic gameplay.

Fishistry kicks off the new Bit-cremental series, where each game will feature a familiar layout but offer unique gameplay twists. It’s an evolving project, and I’m excited to fine-tune it with your feedback as the series grows.

Thank you so much for your support, I can't wait to hear about your experiences.

Happy fishing, and see you soon! :)
